concept:
Character concept for a 2D cut-out animation game. Draw ONE original creature: a long-eared RABBIT GENERAL in jade scale armour, a single-stage Wood creature, in the same view and pose as image 1, leaping in mid-air, one arm raised high and the other stretched out, on a plain white background. A cute, chunky creature, but an original design that must look clearly DIFFERENT from the figure the silhouette came from; not any existing character.

Image 1 (grey silhouette) and image 2 (the same figure split into numbered regions) show the PUPPET RIG the new creature will be animated on. They tell you where each part and joint is, NOT what the creature looks like: do not trace their outline. Viewer-left and viewer-right mean as seen in the picture.

KEEP FROM THE RIG (the animation moves these parts around these joints):
- the same parts, no more, no fewer, each where its numbered region is: 1 rabbit head with face and jade helmet; 2 two long rabbit ears; 3 chest and waist armour with jade disc; 4 raised viewer-left arm; 5 outstretched viewer-right arm with paw; 6 two fluffy rabbit-fur plumes; 7 dark forest-green cloak panels; 8 two rabbit legs with jade greaves; 9 floating bamboo slips; 10 big ebony claw with jade disc;
- every joint where it is and every part pointing the same way as in image 1; eyes where the old eyes are;
- each part about the size and shape of its region; the whole figure about the same size.

CHANGE (the new look, region by region):
1 rabbit head with face and jade helmet: a cute rabbit face turned to the viewer-right with a short animal muzzle and a small dark nose at its right end, ivory-white fur, one big green eye (one catchlight dot) exactly where the old eye is, a brow angled down, a confident closed-mouth smirk, ivory cheek and throat fur below it; behind the head a jade-green scale helmet with a bronze rim whose back edge is layered like leaves, and a long dark forest-green leaf-shaped helmet crest sweeping from the upper-left down to above the eye; an animal face, not a human face; no orange, no flames.
2 two long rabbit ears: ivory-white fur outside, a pale jade-green inner lining and a thin bronze ring near the base of each ear, the same lengths and directions; no red.
3 chest and waist armour with jade disc: ivory fur chest covered by jade-green scale armour with bronze rims; the high collar becomes a jade scale collar with a bronze rim; the hips covered by jade scale armour; a bronze belt buckle holding a round flat jade-green disc carved with a leaf pattern instead of the yin-yang disc; a dark forest-green sash end; two small bronze-and-green cord tassels; no black, no gold, no yin-yang.
4 raised viewer-left arm: the same raised arm in a dark forest-green cloak sleeve covered with jade scale plates, its pointed upper-left tip a jade-green leaf-shaped cuff (no hand drawn); a jade scale shoulder guard with a bronze rim; a bronze arm band carved with small leaves; no black, no gold.
5 outstretched viewer-right arm with paw: a jade scale shoulder pad with a bronze rim at the LEFT end, a dark forest-green sleeve with a jade-green cuff, the flap a jade-green leaf-shaped armour fin, and an open ivory-white furry rabbit paw with small dark claws at the RIGHT end; no pink human hand, no black.
6 two fluffy rabbit-fur plumes: fluffy ivory-white fur in the same two plumes streaming to the viewer-left, with pale jade-green tips, like a big rabbit tail.
7 dark forest-green cloak panels: the skirt and the four tails become long cloak panels in the same places and directions, dark forest green with a bronze hem and a small carved leaf motif near the tips; no black, no grey, no gold swirls.
8 two rabbit legs with jade greaves: ivory-white furry rabbit legs with jade-green scale greaves and bronze-rimmed jade knee guards, big ivory rabbit feet with small dark claws pointing down at the bottom; no black, no red, no silver.
9 floating bamboo slips: the same four floating clusters, but each bar is a flat green bamboo slip carved with a small leaf, tied with a thin bronze cord; no gold, no glow.
10 big ebony claw with jade disc: a big ebony-wood claw: a round flat jade-green disc carved with leaves in the same place as the old disc, a frame of dark ebony wood with leaf-shaped fins instead of the flames, small jade chips instead of the green bars, and three big curved ebony claws hanging from the bottom, each set with a small jade stone; no yin-yang, no flames, no red, no gold, no silver.

ATTITUDE: a proud rabbit general about to strike: brow angled down, a confident closed-mouth smirk; cute, never scary, never a cheerful mascot.

{RENDER}
{DESIGN}
The style sheet is image 3; the hand-drawn map is image 4. Image 5 is an approved character of this game: copy its ink line weight and its pencil and crayon texture, not its design; it has a few white shine spots and some darker shading: do NOT copy those.

COLOURS: ivory-white fur, jade-green scale armour with bronze rims, a dark forest-green cloak, big green eyes, flat green bamboo slips, dark ebony wood, small jade stones. Few colours.

AVOID: black robes or sleeves, red, orange or yellow-gold colours, a yin-yang symbol, gold plates or bars, a human face or human hands, silver claws, flame shapes, glowing green flame wisps, glowing specks, text, labels, numbers, the region colours, frames, background scenery, a second view, shading, shadows, white highlights, glossy shine, glow, gradients.
